page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a brace diagram in the middle; a narrow strip of another page at the right edge (partly visible, not transcribed).

main_text.p: spirituali vi erumpentes accepit & exuit siue expoliauit. Eph.2.15.

Eius testimonium illustrissimum, est solemnis de illis triumphus, quo in cruce tanquam in curru triumphali eas palam traduxit. Ibid. Quod crimen inscriptum (Hic est Rex ille Iudaeorum) obsignabat. Mat.27.37.
Mors Christi, est separatio animae ipsius a corpore, ad testamentum ratum faciendum mortisque metum soluendum. Hebr. 9.15. 16. 17.& 2. 14.15.
main_text.l: sunt: Παραθήσις τῶ πνεύματος εἰς χεῖρας πατρὸς in ipsa expiratione. Transitus eius in paradisum. Luc.23.43. 46.
main_text.p: Proprium est effusio sanguinis & aquae, propter λευράν & sic περικαρδίαν transfixam, nullo confracto osse. Ioh.19.34.38.39.40.
Sepultura, est corporis inhumatio, vt cum ipso sepeliamur peccato. Rom.6.4.

page.notes: The right edge shows part of the facing page (fragments such as "mor", "ctes", "Mat.", "les f", "Pfal.", "Hu", "dupl", "Refi", "Marc") which is not transcribed. The Greek words are transcribed as best read; the brace diagram was given as a single lined block. Several Greek words (e.g. "ἈδῶΝ" marked 'Ad̃') are uncertain.
